description: The LenovoThinkCentre M700 Tiny is a compact yet powerful business-class mini desktop designed for office work, study, billing, business applications, and everyday computing. Powered by an INTELCorei5 6th Gen processor with 8GB RAM and a fast 256GB SSD, it delivers smooth multitasking, quick boot times, and responsive performance. Its ultra-compact Tiny form factor saves valuable desk space, making it ideal for offices, retail counters, workstations, and home setups. Pre-installed with Win 11 Pro, MS Office 2021, and WiFi support, it is ready to use right out of the box. Equipped with HDMI, VGA, DVI, USB, DisplayPort, and Ethernet connectivity, it easily connects to monitors, printers, and other peripherals. Professionally Pre-Owned & Tested for reliable performance, this space-saving desktop is built to deliver dependable productivity and long-lasting business-class reliability.
